title: We are here, on the frontline of sexual health / against discrimination
slide_intent: Use concrete subjects to ground an advocacy statement. The photograph gives a reader a point of entry before the words name the concern.
strategic_value: The paired scenes can connect sexual health and opposition to discrimination within the same campaign voice.
demonstration: A close-up of a condom demonstration and a portrait occupy adjacent panels. Their headlines use the repeated opening with different endings and color treatments.
practical_value: Choose a photograph and headline that make sense together, and describe what appears without assigning a health status or identity to a person pictured.

content_islands.name: Demonstration panel
content_islands.spec: Place the demonstration at left, keeping the hand action legible above the pink headline block.

content_islands.name: Portrait panel
content_islands.spec: Fill the right panel with the portrait. Place the blue-on-black declaration in the lower-right field to keep the face clear.
